from shop.renewal import renewal_allowed
from shop.booking import booking_allowed
from shop.quote import quote_discount
from shop.reports import nightly_report
from shop.checkout import checkout


def test_grace_copies():
    assert renewal_allowed(0)
    assert booking_allowed(0, False)
    assert quote_discount(0, 100) == 10
    assert nightly_report([{"name": "ann", "amount": 5, "days_late": 0}])[0] == "Ann: 5 [in-grace]"
    assert checkout({"items": [{"price": 10}], "member": True, "days_late": 0})["blocked"] is False
